stem: A laptop promotion sold 900 units against a baseline of 500, and the analyst reports 400 incremental units. Sister laptops lost 120 units in the same weeks, and the 2 weeks after sold 80 units below baseline. What is wrong with the report?

options.text: Nothing: sister laptops are other products, so 400 is right
400 is the gross lift; net of both, 200 are incremental
Adding the sister laptops' loss, 520 units are incremental
Netting only the later dip, 320 units are incremental
